LanguageData.Ratkin_CaravanMerchant.title: Ratkin Caravan Merchant
LanguageData.Ratkin_CaravanMerchant.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a merchant who led a caravan from place to place. After a raid took everything, [PAWN_pronoun] decided to begin a new life.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Wanderer.title: Ratkin Wanderer
LanguageData.Ratkin_Wanderer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was simply a wanderer with no fixed destination. To [PAWN_pronoun], a life spent tending a garden was little more than a pretty dream.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Farmer.title: Ratkin Farmer
LanguageData.Ratkin_Farmer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a farmer. [PAWN_pronoun] inherited the family trade from [PAWN_possessive] parents, and [PAWN_possessive] children were expected to become farmers as well.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Miner.title: Ratkin Miner
LanguageData.Ratkin_Miner.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made use of [PAWN_possessive] strengths and became a miner. Digging was easy for [PAWN_pronoun], but [PAWN_pronoun] often longed to escape the cramped, stifling tunnels.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Hunter.title: Ratkin Hunter
LanguageData.Ratkin_Hunter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hunted wild animals. Unlike most Ratkins, [PAWN_pronoun] had keen eyesight and could spot moving animals from far away.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Shepherd.title: Ratkin Shepherd
LanguageData.Ratkin_Shepherd.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran a ranch with many animals, but after a polluted ship crashed nearby, that life became nothing more than a memory.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Civil.title: Ratkin Civil
LanguageData.Ratkin_Civil.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a citizen of the Ratkin Kingdom, making a living through odd jobs within the kingdom.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Noble.title: Ratkin Noble
LanguageData.Ratkin_Noble.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a noble of the Ratkin Kingdom. After being caught up in a political incident and forced into exile, [PAWN_pronoun] began wandering in hopes of one day returning.
LanguageData.Ratkin_CityMerchant.title: Ratkin City Merchant
LanguageData.Ratkin_CityMerchant.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a city merchant. Skilled with [PAWN_possessive] hands, [PAWN_pronoun] sold all kinds of goods at the market.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Librarian.title: Ratkin Librarian
LanguageData.Ratkin_Librarian.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a librarian who guarded the library. [PAWN_pronoun] gained deep scholarly knowledge, but life among books lasted long enough for [PAWN_pronoun] to forget how to dig.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Guardener.title: Ratkin Guardener
LanguageData.Ratkin_Guardener.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was one of Ratkin society's finest Gardeners. During a mission in foreign lands, [PAWN_pronoun] was separated from the others and now seeks a way back to the kingdom.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Knight.title: Ratkin Knight
LanguageData.Ratkin_Knight.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a knight of the Ratkin Kingdom. Knights are the pillars that support the kingdom and fierce warriors in their own right.
LanguageData.Ratkin_KnightCommander.title: Ratkin Knight commander
LanguageData.Ratkin_KnightCommander.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a chosen knight of the Ratkin Kingdom. By knightly tradition, the commander's successor is selected from knights born in the countryside.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Teacher.title: Ratkin Teacher
LanguageData.Ratkin_Teacher.description: [PAWN_nameDef] taught children. But when every child left the rural village, there was nothing left for [PAWN_pronoun] to do, so [PAWN_pronoun] set out to find a new place with a future.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Blacksmith.title: Ratkin Blacksmith
LanguageData.Ratkin_Blacksmith.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a blacksmith who made weapons and tools. [PAWN_pronoun] set out in search of stronger materials.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Thief.title: Ratkin Thief
LanguageData.Ratkin_Thief.description: [PAWN_nameDef] survived day to day by stealing. Whenever [PAWN_possessive] face became known in one city, [PAWN_pronoun] moved on to another.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Ambassador.title: Ratkin Ambassador
LanguageData.Ratkin_Ambassador.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a diplomat of the Ratkin Kingdom. A diplomatic dispute forced [PAWN_pronoun] into temporary exile.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Soldier.title: Ratkin Soldier
LanguageData.Ratkin_Soldier.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a soldier in a human city. Trained among humans, [PAWN_pronoun] learned fighting methods unlike those of other Ratkins. After being abandoned during a mission, [PAWN_pronoun] decided to seek a new life.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Explorer.title: Ratkin Explorer
LanguageData.Ratkin_Explorer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was overflowing with curiosity about the world. [PAWN_pronoun] does not intend to stop until [PAWN_pronoun] has explored the entire planetary system.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Chef.title: Ratkin Chef
LanguageData.Ratkin_Chef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a chef with the ambition to cook everything in the world. [PAWN_pronoun] set out to find the finest nut of all.
LanguageData.Ratkin_HandMaiden.title: Ratkin HandMaiden
LanguageData.Ratkin_HandMaiden.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served a noble as a handmaiden, handling small errands and sometimes acting as the noble's eyes and ears.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Shooter.title: Ratkin Shooter
LanguageData.Ratkin_Shooter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had unusually good eyesight for a Ratkin. [PAWN_pronoun] used that advantage to volunteer for the military and became an exceptional marksman.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Doctor.title: Ratkin Doctor
LanguageData.Ratkin_Doctor.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a royal physician, but after failing to save a noble, [PAWN_pronoun] was exiled to the frontier. [PAWN_pronoun] traveled from place to place, honing [PAWN_possessive] medical skills to prove [PAWN_pronoun] had not been wrong.
LanguageData.Ratkin_ArmySurgeon.title: Ratkin Army Surgeon
LanguageData.Ratkin_ArmySurgeon.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a surgeon who saved Ratkins on the battlefield. Even the smallest life was kin to [PAWN_pronoun], and duty led [PAWN_pronoun] to volunteer, but [PAWN_pronoun] eventually left after realizing nothing would change.
LanguageData.Ratkin_ConstructionWorker.title: Ratkin Construction Worker
LanguageData.Ratkin_ConstructionWorker.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked on construction sites, mostly building underground tunnels.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Rich.title: Ratkin Rich
LanguageData.Ratkin_Rich.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had a remarkable talent for making money by deceiving others. Before long, [PAWN_pronoun] was exposed and had no choice but to flee.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Sister.title: Ratkin Sister
LanguageData.Ratkin_Sister.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a sister who handled rites and religious duties in Ratkin society. While traveling far for a ceremony, [PAWN_pronoun] was attacked and barely escaped.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Butcher.title: Ratkin Butcher
LanguageData.Ratkin_Butcher.description: [PAWN_nameDef] slaughtered animals and sold the meat.
LanguageData.Ratkin_CityMaid.title: Ratkin City Maid
LanguageData.Ratkin_CityMaid.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a domestic helper in the city. Humans tended to hire only handsome Ratkins as household staff, and [PAWN_pronoun] was one of them.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Idol.title: Ratkin Idol
LanguageData.Ratkin_Idol.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked in entertainment as an idol. Unfortunately, the vehicle [PAWN_pronoun] was riding overturned, and [PAWN_pronoun] woke in an unknown place.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Murderer.title: Ratkin Murderer
LanguageData.Ratkin_Murderer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a Ratkin driven mad in the city. Using [PAWN_possessive] small body to flee crime scenes quickly, [PAWN_pronoun] came to enjoy murder.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Assistant.title: Ratkin Assistant
LanguageData.Ratkin_Assistant.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a research assistant, helping humans with studies both small and large. Whenever possible, [PAWN_pronoun] learned by watching over their shoulders.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Scientist.title: Ratkin Scientist
LanguageData.Ratkin_Scientist.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a scientist who studied among humans. But [PAWN_pronoun] became so absorbed in research that [PAWN_pronoun] grew physically frail and ruined [PAWN_possessive] eyesight.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Engineer.title: Ratkin Engineer
LanguageData.Ratkin_Engineer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an engineer who made precision components. [PAWN_pronoun] used [PAWN_possessive] talent to build a mechanoid, never realizing it would become the source of disaster.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Agriculturist.title: Ratkin Agriculturist
LanguageData.Ratkin_Agriculturist.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an agricultural scholar who left for the city to improve Ratkin farming. [PAWN_pronoun] dreams of returning home one day to advance agriculture there.
LanguageData.Ratkin_RatkinHunter.title: RatkinHunter
LanguageData.Ratkin_RatkinHunter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hunted down runaway Ratkins. One day, after seeing a young Ratkin fugitive, [PAWN_pronoun] began to doubt [PAWN_possessive] work and simply walked away.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Subject.title: Ratkin Subject
LanguageData.Ratkin_Subject.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a Ratkin test subject. Various experiments enhanced [PAWN_pronoun], but an accident during testing gave [PAWN_pronoun] a narrow chance to escape.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Vagabond.title: Ratkin Vagabond
LanguageData.Ratkin_Vagabond.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lived as a wanderer with no destination. [PAWN_possessive] exact past is unknown, but the wisdom [PAWN_pronoun] gained on the road seems reliable enough.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Demoman.title: Ratkin Demoman
LanguageData.Ratkin_Demoman.description: Unlike other Ratkins, [PAWN_nameDef] was fanatically obsessed with explosions. [PAWN_pronoun] used that talent to volunteer for a Ratkin commando unit.
LanguageData.Ratkin_WildChild.title: Ratkin wild born
LanguageData.Ratkin_WildChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the wild without the benefits of civilization. The harsh wilderness made [PAWN_pronoun] strong, but left [PAWN_pronoun] without a proper education.
LanguageData.Ratkin_LandRat.title: Ratkin land rat
LanguageData.Ratkin_LandRat.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in darkness. Years of cave life made [PAWN_pronoun] skilled at digging, but when many of [PAWN_possessive] kin went to the surface, [PAWN_pronoun] stayed behind.
LanguageData.Ratkin_CountryKid.title: Ratkin country kid
LanguageData.Ratkin_CountryKid.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s grandparents were farmers, and so were [PAWN_possessive] parents. By family tradition, [PAWN_pronoun] would be a farmer too. The line was expected to continue.
LanguageData.Ratkin_ShepherdBoy.title: Ratkin shepherd boy
LanguageData.Ratkin_ShepherdBoy.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up among many kinds of livestock. [PAWN_pronoun] thinks of animals as friends.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Orphan.title: Ratkin orphan
LanguageData.Ratkin_Orphan.description: Abandoned early, [PAWN_nameDef] never had parents. [PAWN_pronoun] had to survive alone, so while [PAWN_pronoun] lacks specialized knowledge, [PAWN_pronoun] can handle many different tasks.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Student.title: Ratkin student
LanguageData.Ratkin_Student.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s family was not wealthy, but not so poor that [PAWN_pronoun] could not study. [PAWN_pronoun] was good at academic work, though [PAWN_possessive] marks in physical education were never impressive.
LanguageData.Ratkin_LittleLibrarian.title: Ratkin little librarian
LanguageData.Ratkin_LittleLibrarian.description: With librarians for parents, [PAWN_nameDef] lived among piles of books. Those books broadened and deepened [PAWN_possessive] education, but also left [PAWN_pronoun] barely able to see without glasses.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GoldenSpoon.title: Ratkin golden spoon
LanguageData.Ratkin_GoldenSpoon.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a wealthy family that lacked for nothing. Raised like a precious treasure among countless artworks, [PAWN_pronoun] never learned to do much of anything.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Bastard.title: Ratkin bastard
LanguageData.Ratkin_Bastard.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born the child of a concubine. After scheming to become heir and being exposed, [PAWN_pronoun] became a fugitive.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Successor.title: Ratkin successor
LanguageData.Ratkin_Successor.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born heir to a noble house. When the once-brilliant family began to decline, [PAWN_pronoun] had to leave in order to restore it.
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuardenerStudent.title: Ratkin Guardener Student
LanguageData.Ratkin_GuardenerStudent.description: [PAWN_nameDef] entered training to become a Gardener. In Ratkin society only the best may protect the gardens, so [PAWN_pronoun] had to work with relentless dedication.
LanguageData.Ratkin_ChefStudent.title: Ratkin Chef Student
LanguageData.Ratkin_ChefStudent.description: [PAWN_nameDef] began cooking because [PAWN_pronoun] loved eating. Food was one of life's great joys for [PAWN_pronoun], so [PAWN_pronoun] set out in search of even better flavors.
LanguageData.Ratkin_RomanyKid.title: Ratkin Romany Kid
LanguageData.Ratkin_RomanyKid.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lived on the road, drifting from place to place. [PAWN_pronoun] is versatile, but a rootless life left little room for deep bonds with others.
LanguageData.Ratkin_OfficerChild.title: Ratkin Officer Child
LanguageData.Ratkin_OfficerChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born the child of an officer. The shooting skill and charisma [PAWN_pronoun] learned from [PAWN_possessive] parents made [PAWN_pronoun] officer material, but also made [PAWN_pronoun] arrogant.
LanguageData.Ratkin_MerchantKid.title: Ratkin Merchant Kid
LanguageData.Ratkin_MerchantKid.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a caravan. By watching [PAWN_possessive] parents trade, [PAWN_pronoun] learned how money is made.
LanguageData.Ratkin_Kid.title: Ratkin Kid
LanguageData.Ratkin_Kid.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an ordinary child. In an ordinary household, [PAWN_pronoun] learned bits and pieces by watching [PAWN_possessive] parents work. Without access to higher education, [PAWN_pronoun] never gained specialized knowledge.
LanguageData.Ratkin_ServentChild.title: Ratkin Servent Child
LanguageData.Ratkin_ServentChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born the child of a servant. By law, [PAWN_pronoun] was destined to become a servant too, but [PAWN_pronoun] fled to change [PAWN_possessive] own fate.
LanguageData.Ratkin_HumanAssistant.title: Ratkin Human Assistant
LanguageData.Ratkin_HumanAssistant.description: [PAWN_nameDef] assisted a human from childhood, helping with small tasks. When [PAWN_possessive] master died in an accident, [PAWN_pronoun] set out to find a life of [PAWN_possessive] own.
LanguageData.Ratkin_CityKid.title: Ratkin City Kid
LanguageData.Ratkin_CityKid.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in the city. Exposure to urban civilization allowed [PAWN_pronoun] to understand technology and culture more easily than other Ratkins.
LanguageData.Ratkin_SlaveKid.title: Ratkin Slave Kid
LanguageData.Ratkin_SlaveKid.description: [PAWN_nameDef] does not know how it happened, but [PAWN_pronoun] bears a slave brand. After enduring endless menial work, [PAWN_pronoun] fled in search of freedom.
LanguageData.Ratkin_LaboratoryRats.title: Ratkin Specimen
LanguageData.Ratkin_LaboratoryRats.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in a human laboratory as a genetically modified military specimen. Feeling a deep longing for freedom, [PAWN_pronoun] resolved to escape.
LanguageData.Ratkin_PettyTheft.title: Ratkin Petty Theft
LanguageData.Ratkin_PettyTheft.description: To [PAWN_nameDef], stealing was only borrowing for a moment. [PAWN_possessive] frequent thefts eventually caught up with [PAWN_pronoun], and while being taken away as a slave, a raid gave [PAWN_pronoun] a narrow chance to escape.
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_Gypsy.title: Ratkin traveling performer
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_Gypsy.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a traveling entertainer who moved from village to village, making a living through song and dance. [PAWN_pronoun] is skilled at getting along with people.
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_RefugeeSlave.title: Ratkin escaped slave
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_RefugeeSlave.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a refugee who barely escaped slavery. [PAWN_pronoun] survived through hard labor and endurance.
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_WanderingRefugee.title: Ratkin wandering refugee
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_WanderingRefugee.descriptio: [PAWN_nameDef] is a refugee who lost [PAWN_possessive] home to war and now wanders. [PAWN_pronoun] is searching for a place to settle and begin a new life.
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_CaravanLeader.title: Ratkin caravan merchant
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_CaravanLeader.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a wandering merchant. [PAWN_pronoun] travels between villages trading supplies and connecting those who wish to settle.
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_WanderingMercenary.title: Ratkin hired mercenary
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_WanderingMercenary.descript: [PAWN_nameDef] is a wandering mercenary who has moved from battlefield to battlefield. [PAWN_pronoun] is skilled in combat and searching for a new employer.
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_WandererChild.title: wandering child
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_WandererChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has lived without a fixed home since childhood. Unable to stay in one place, [PAWN_pronoun] learned to survive while wandering.
